about.body: The N55 is BMW's turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, produced from 2009 to 2020. It was BMW's first mass-produced turbocharged straight-six to use a single twin-scroll turbocharger with Valvetronic, and served as the mainstream six-cylinder petrol option across multiple model lines before being succeeded by the B58. Fitted to the 1 Series, 2 Series, 5 Series, 6 Series, M2 (early production), X5 and X6 — it's an engine we've worked on extensively across seven different applications.

byModel.body: The N55 featured across the 1 Series in the M135i (F20/F21, 2011–2016), and in the 2 Series as the M235i (F22/F23, 2014–2016) before the M240i B58 took over. The 5 Series used it in the 535i (F10/F11, 2010–2016), and the 6 Series in the 640i (F06/F12/F13, 2011–2018). Early production M2 (F87, 2015–2016) used the N55 before the M2 Competition's S55 was introduced. Across the SUV range, it appeared in the X5 xDrive35i (F15, 2013–2018) and the X6 xDrive35i (F16, 2014–2019).

compatibility.body: Because the N55 spans seven different models and multiple generations, compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. An N55 from a 1 Series M135i isn't a drop-in match for an N55 from an X5 xDrive35i — ancillaries, mounting, and drivetrain configuration all differ. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
